kill_rules.K1: predicate not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a battery forgery accepted by r92, the positive refused, or r91 refuses a forgery (no discrimination)
kill_rules.K3: a genuine row moved or the verification path wrote the receipts directory
kill_rules.K4: the pass skips the work: missing receipt accepted, committed receipt not read, substring token match, duplicate pin path scored, or self-pin minted in verify

named_limits: a coherent joint edit of instrument, pin, receipt and expectation row survives (that edit is the harness)
whole-token matching binds one field per token, not its semantic role
the self-pin detects a moved byte inside a named commit, not a rewritten history
the minus-self digest binds the table's coherence, not its authority
a pinned script that reads data outside its own bytes is unseen
the exact-gate repair is vacuous-in-practice (committed_ok implies exact_ok row-for-row) and is not cited as a gain
